messages:
Maya: Heads-up — spotted a regression in staging after the 0.9.3 -> 0.9.4 rollout. /batch-infer 95th latency doubled, KV cache hit rate dropped. Can we do a quick sync in 30m? I'll open a bridge. @Sanjay @Alex @Jen

deploy-bot: [alert] rollout 0.9.4 -> staging failed: 503 spike from gateway (svc: inference-gw). See logs: https://internal.logs/rollouts/17799 :rotating_light:

Sanjay: On it, joining. Can you paste the bridge and a very short agenda?

Maya: Bridge: https://meet.rdwd.io/bridge-1234 (pw: rdw-infer). Agenda: 1) quick triage (2-3 checks) 2) decide rollback vs hotfix 3) assign postmortem owner. Bring last config diff + kvcache stats.

Alex: I'll grab kernel selection + batcher traces. If anyone has the exact time window of the spike that helps (approx minute).

Jen: I'm on call, can trigger a rollback if we go that route. Quick ask: avoid restarting dedupe worker during rollback — it can double-process jobs.

Racheal: (eng-ml) joining in ~5. Did a quick diff: quantize flags in model config changed between 0.9.3 and 0.9.4 — could be related to tokenization seq growth?

Logan: I just opened a small change to batching heuristics (PR #421). If we rollback, happy to hold merge. Not a blocker but FYI.

ops-oncall: Added a warroom channel: #incident-1779954321, will mirror important notes here. Allocated logging retention for the window.

Maya: Starting bridge now, joining. Quick checklist for triage: - confirm time window and metric (Alex) - check kvcache evictions and hit-rate (Sanjay) - model config diff (Racheal) - gating for rollback if >50% error increase (Jen).

Alex: Found spikes at 2026-03-18T15:07:30Z -> 15:11:10Z in batcher latency. Attached a small snippet: ```trace: batcher.loop: 15:07:31 evict start, kv_hits 0.24 -> 0.05```

Sanjay: kvcache shows eviction storm at same window, caused by longer sequence lengths from a single client test runner (noisy client). Rolling back client test would reduce pressure.

Jen: Can we enable standby kvcache warmup to reduce misses quickly? Ops: is that a toggle or a deploy?

ops-oncall: Standby warmup is a runtime flag, can flip on staging. Doing it now.

deploy-bot: action: set-flag standby_kv_warmup=true by ops-oncall at 1779954680 — status: success

Maya: Good. If warmup doesn't bring hit-rate back within 5 minutes, we fallback to rollback. Assigning owners: postmortem — Maya; rollback lead — Jen; kvcache debug — Sanjay; model config check — Racheal.

Alex: Warmup helped the hit-rate jump from 5% -> 42% in 90s. Latency trending down.

Logan: Nice, will hold my PR for now. Ping me if you want a fast repro harness to test burst behavior.

Jen: Since warmup fixed it, no rollback. We'll keep monitoring for 30m and then close the incident. :thumbsup:

Maya: Closing bridge in 30. If anything changes, update #incident-1779954321 and drop a note here. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

deploy-bot: incident-1779954321: status set to monitoring by Maya at 1779954920

Maya: FYI — I'll open an RFC for a safer kvcache warmup-by-default change and include a test harness for noisy clients.

Sanjay: Echo — will add a small diag to catch noisy-client seq len anomalies and auto-throttle.

Jen: Marking follow-ups: RFC (Maya), diag + auto-throttle (Sanjay), postmortem doc (Maya + Racheal).
